cublasdx_block_gemm.source: tools/bench/cublasdx_block_bench.cu, MathDx 25.6.0 headers (nvidia-mathdx wheel, scratch only)
cublasdx_block_gemm.problem: 2048 independent 64x64x64 FP32 block GEMMs, one CTA per tile
cublasdx_block_gemm.verdict: Fails the within-5% primitive gate on its own block-tile problem; no regional consumer prototype built.

independent_branch_streams.verdict: No reliable critical-path gain: slower on the small case, neutral (<=1.5%) on large cases. Persistent task-graph scheduling is not justified by this probe.

radial_producer_convolution.verdict: Not reopened. The cuBLASDx primitive gate failed, and the SIMT form of this fusion already failed twice (research triton_conv_probe and FastMACE OPT2-T01, in-kernel weight generation at 18% of FMA peak, backward materialisation unchanged).

persistent_task_graph.verdict: Not justified. Graph gaps are ~0.5% on NbCl5 and the stream probe shows no overlap headroom on large cases.
